title: An erase killed during its Apple Health step leaves pre-erase reminder notifications pending
evidence: Checkpoint 4 look-back. Design note first. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DataEraser.swift erase() runs, in order: the record erase (:138), chat refresh (:141), the refused check (:142), then health?.erased (:146), which waits up to drainBound for a running pass and asks Health to delete (AppleHealthSync.swift:298-303; AppleHealthOwed.swift:26-40), then live?.forget (:147), keepUnits (:148), and only last reminders?.refresh (:149), which removes the pending notifications. A kill or crash during the Health step (the slowest, with a drain wait) leaves the pre-erase generic notifications pending: they fire after the record is erased. The next launch's refresh ends them, but one may fire first. Fix: clear pending reminder notifications as soon as the outcome is not refused (right after :142), keeping the later refresh. DataEraser.swift is off-limits to this thread: file-only lead. US-25 AC16; US-11 AC4 File-only for now (owner 2026-11-14): S68 needs DataEraser.swift, which stays off-limits.
